analysis_zh.summary_zh: 该论文针对英语-白俄罗斯语机器翻译，提出了一个白俄罗斯语专用的数据清洗流程，并在此基础上对模型进行微调。清洗流程的特色在于引入纠正工具，处理白俄罗斯语两种正字法、训练数据噪声、其他语言干扰以及互联网上常见的拼写错误。在未过滤训练数据上进行的匹配消融实验显示，过滤对所有微调模型都有显著收益，其中基于大语言模型的模型从过滤中获得的提升约为专用编码器-解码器翻译系统的两倍，支持数据质量是白俄罗斯语机器翻译主要瓶颈之一的观点。
innovations_zh: 提出白俄罗斯语专用数据清洗流程，处理两种正字法问题
清洗流程同时应对噪声、语言干扰和常见拼写错误
通过匹配消融实验量化过滤对不同模型类型的收益差异
analysis_zh.significance: 该工作聚焦于白俄罗斯语这一低资源语言的机器翻译，通过数据清洗流程直接回应了数据质量瓶颈问题。研究结果为低资源语言机器翻译中数据预处理的重要性提供了实证支持，并提示大语言模型在数据质量改善后可能获得更大收益。
analysis_zh.limitations: 摘要仅报告了过滤与未过滤的消融对比，未提供具体评测指标、数据集规模或翻译质量数值。清洗流程针对白俄罗斯语设计，其有效性是否可迁移至其他低资源语言尚不明确。此外，摘要未说明所使用的大语言模型和专用翻译系统的具体配置，结论的普适性有待验证。
analysis_zh.potential: 未来可进一步探索该清洗流程中不同组件对翻译质量的独立贡献，以及将其适配到其他具有正字法变体或类似噪声问题的低资源语言。长期来看，结合更精细的数据筛选与模型微调策略，有望持续缓解低资源语言机器翻译的数据质量瓶颈。

title: When Steering Fails in Latent Reasoning: A Latent-to-Language Transition Gap
abstract: Activation steering has become a widely used approach for controlling language models during explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, motivating its extension to latent CoT. However, we find that steering continuous thoughts produces substantially weaker effects on subsequent language generation than steering explicit CoT, even when the hidden representations are moved by comparable amounts. We first show that task information remains identifiable in continuous thoughts. Hence, we hypothesize a \textbf{latent-to-language transition gap}, in which an intervention effect in latent space fails to transfer to language generation. Two further results support this hypothesis: the output distribution changes abruptly at the transition boundary, and task-related directions exert much weaker bidirectional control in latent CoT than in explicit CoT. These findings identify the transition interface as a central target for evaluating and designing future latent-steering methods.
summary: Activation steering has become a widely used approach for controlling language models during explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, motivating its extension to latent CoT.
innovations: We first show that task information remains identifiable in continuous thoughts.
score_reasons: LLM 核心关键词强命中 (+0.8)

analysis_zh.summary_zh: 该研究关注激活引导在潜在链式思维推理中的效果，发现引导连续思维对后续语言生成的影响明显弱于引导显式链式思维，即使隐藏表示被移动的幅度相当。作者首先确认任务信息在连续思维中仍可识别，进而提出“潜在到语言过渡鸿沟”假设。两项进一步结果支持该假设：输出分布在过渡边界处突然变化，且任务相关方向在潜在链式思维中的双向控制力远弱于显式链式思维。
innovations_zh: 发现潜在链式思维中激活引导效果显著弱于显式链式思维
提出潜在到语言过渡鸿沟假设解释引导失效现象
揭示输出分布在过渡边界突变及任务方向控制力减弱
analysis_zh.significance: 研究意义：该工作揭示了激活引导从潜在推理迁移到语言生成时的关键障碍，即过渡接口处的效果衰减。它为评估和设计未来潜在引导方法指明了核心目标，有助于推动对潜在链式思维可控性的理解。
analysis_zh.limitations: 研究不足之处：摘要仅报告了现象与假设，未说明具体模型、任务和评测规模，结论的普适性有待验证。此外，未提供过渡鸿沟的机制性解释或缓解方案，仅基于摘要难以判断其在不同架构和任务上的稳健性。
analysis_zh.potential: 未来研究潜力：可围绕过渡接口设计专门的引导或对齐方法，以缩小潜在到语言的迁移差距。长期看，理解该鸿沟有助于提升潜在推理的可控性与可解释性，并推动更有效的潜在链式思维引导技术。

title: Displacement Geometry Captures Platonic Shared Reality Across Models and Modalities
abstract: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) claims that independently trained models converge on a shared statistical model of reality, yet recent work finds only weak pointwise similarity between models. In this paper, we show that what models share is not the location of samples in representation space, but the directions (displacement vectors) between them. Under a single orthogonal alignment--rotation and reflection only--these displacement vectors are substantially preserved across 44 independently trained vision and language encoders spanning modalities and asymmetric capability pairs, consistent with the PRH evidence. The samples' absolute positions are not, consistent with recent counter-evidence. Both arise from a single decomposition: representations split into a shared semantic component that is linearly aligned across models, and a private capability component that is not. We trace this geometry to concept-level structure: within a model, parent concepts are orthogonal to their child variation vectors; across models, concept displacements are parallel. Our theory falsifiably predicts (and experiments confirm) that fine-tuning preserves pointwise similarity but collapses displacement, and that relational distillation does the opposite. A major implication is that, because semantics align linearly but capabilities do not, capabilities can be imported from one model to another using a single cached forward pass through the source. We call this Shadow Casting. As a proof of concept, our SHADOWCLIP instantiation outperforms strong fine-tuned baselines at orders of magnitude less compute. A cache can be released alongside open model weights, letting one model's capabilities be downloaded and imported into any number of other models without fine-tuning.
summary: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) claims that independently trained models converge on a shared statistical model of reality, yet recent work finds only weak pointwise similarity between models. In this paper, we show that what models share is not the location of samples in representation space, but the directions (displacement vectors) between them.
innovations: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) claims that independently trained models converge on a shared statistical model of reality, yet recent work finds only weak pointwise similarity between models.
score_reasons: 摘要声称 SOTA / 显著提升 (+0.5)

analysis_zh.summary_zh: 针对柏拉图表示假说中模型间仅存在弱逐点相似性的争议，本文提出模型共享的不是样本在表示空间中的位置，而是样本间的位移向量。在仅允许旋转和反射的正交对齐下，44个独立训练的视觉与语言编码器间的位移向量被显著保留，而绝对位置则不然。作者将表示分解为线性对齐的共享语义成分与不对齐的私有能力成分，并据此预测和验证了微调与关系蒸馏对逐点相似性和位移的相反影响。基于此提出Shadow Casting，用单次缓存前向传播将能力从源模型导入其他模型，SHADOWCLIP以远低算力超越强微调基线。
innovations_zh: 提出模型共享的是位移向量而非样本绝对位置的新观点
将表示分解为线性对齐的共享语义与私有能力成分
可证伪地预测微调与关系蒸馏对位移的相反效应
提出Shadow Casting，用缓存前向传播跨模型导入能力
analysis_zh.significance: 该工作调和了柏拉图表示假说的支持与反证证据，将共享现实从点位置转向位移几何，为理解跨模型、跨模态表示对齐提供了新视角。其能力导入机制表明无需微调即可复用源模型能力，对模型复用与高效迁移具有重要启发。
analysis_zh.limitations: 结论主要基于44个视觉与语言编码器的实验，是否适用于其他模态、任务或更大规模模型尚不确定。摘要未说明位移保留的定量程度与失败条件，且Shadow Casting的通用性仅由SHADOWCLIP单一实例验证。
analysis_zh.potential: 未来可探索位移几何在更多模态与架构中的普适性，以及能力成分的可分离性与组合方式。Shadow Casting若推广，可能形成模型能力缓存与即插即用的新范式，降低迁移与部署成本。

title: A Semiotics-Aware Framework for Evaluating Fidelity and Coverage in Natural Language Generation
abstract: When two texts describe the same expression, standard metrics based on lexical overlap or whole-text similarity may fail to detect meaningful differences in how that expression is framed. We propose a framework to evaluate semiotic alignment between texts, where a semiotic profile encompasses both the contextual meaning and the discourse references made salient by a text. Our approach yields two scores, Semiotic Fidelity and Semiotic Coverage, estimating how much of one text's profile is supported by the other and how much of the other's profile it recovers. Experiments show that coverage is typically lower than fidelity, and that alignment between LLMs and human-curated data is highest at low sampling temperatures, while higher temperatures reduce this alignment.
summary: When two texts describe the same expression, standard metrics based on lexical overlap or whole-text similarity may fail to detect meaningful differences in how that expression is framed. We propose a framework to evaluate semiotic alignment between texts, where a semiotic profile encompasses both the contextual meaning and the discourse references made salient by a text. Experiments show that coverage is typically lower than fidelity, and that alignment between LLMs and human-curated data is highest at low sampling temperatures, while higher temperatures reduce this alignment.
innovations: We propose a framework to evaluate semiotic alignment between texts, where a semiotic profile encompasses both the contextual meaning and the discourse references made salient by a text.
score_reasons: LLM 核心关键词强命中 (+0.8)

analysis_zh.summary_zh: 该论文针对同一表达的不同文本描述，指出基于词汇重叠或整篇相似度的标准指标可能无法检测出表达框架上的有意义差异。作者提出一个评估文本间符号学对齐的框架，其中符号学画像涵盖语境意义和文本所凸显的话语指称，并据此给出符号学保真度与符号学覆盖度两个分数，分别估计一个文本的画像被另一个文本支持的程度以及前者恢复后者画像的程度。实验显示覆盖度通常低于保真度，且大语言模型与人工整理数据之间的对齐在低采样温度下最高，温度升高会降低这种对齐。
innovations_zh: 提出符号学对齐评估框架，涵盖语境意义与话语指称
设计保真度与覆盖度双分数，分别衡量支持与恢复程度
揭示覆盖度通常低于保真度这一系统性现象
发现采样温度影响大语言模型与人工数据的对齐程度
analysis_zh.significance: 该工作回应了标准文本生成指标难以捕捉同一表达在框架与指称上差异的问题，为自然语言生成评估提供了符号学视角下的新维度。其双分数设计有助于更细致地诊断生成文本与参考文本之间的信息支持与覆盖关系，对评估指标的改进具有启发意义。
analysis_zh.limitations: 摘要未说明符号学画像的具体构建方式、两个分数的计算细节以及实验所用的数据集与人工标注流程，因此框架的可复现性与泛化性尚不明确。实验结论主要基于大语言模型与人工整理数据的对齐以及采样温度的影响，其适用范围可能受限于特定模型、任务或语言。此外，摘要未报告与现有标准指标的定量对比，新框架的相对优势仍需进一步验证。
analysis_zh.potential: 未来可进一步明确符号学画像的构建与评分机制，并在多语言、多任务和多模型设定下检验框架的稳健性。可将保真度与覆盖度同现有指标结合，用于生成系统的诊断与优化，或探索温度之外的其他解码与提示因素对符号学对齐的影响。长期看，该方向有望推动评估从表层相似走向意义与指称层面的细粒度分析。

title: Energy-guided Recursive Model
abstract: Recursive models show promise on reasoning and language tasks, yet their test-time scaling lacks a principled criterion for selecting trajectories or determining recurrent depth. We introduce \textbf{Energy-guided Recursive Model (ERM)}, which uses Hopfield-type memories of valid local and global structures to assign intrinsic energies to candidate trajectories. These energies guide candidate selection and suggest an effective range of recurrent depths, implying that deeper recurrence does not necessarily improve reasoning accuracy. They also enable sampling methods such as parallel tempering to improve exploration. For reasoning tasks, ERM achieves optimal solutions on Sudoku ($98.97\%$), Pencil Puzzle Bench (PPBench, $88.04\%$) and Maze ($99.30\%$), reaching the best accuracy in recursive modeling. On language modeling, ERM reduces RedPajama-V2 perplexity by $1.74\%$ with marginal inference overhead. The results support energy guidance as a practical framework for improving test-time scaling in recursive models.
summary: Recursive models show promise on reasoning and language tasks, yet their test-time scaling lacks a principled criterion for selecting trajectories or determining recurrent depth. We introduce \textbf{Energy-guided Recursive Model (ERM)}, which uses Hopfield-type memories of valid local and global structures to assign intrinsic energies to candidate trajectories.
innovations: We introduce \textbf{Energy-guided Recursive Model (ERM)}, which uses Hopfield-type memories of valid local and global structures to assign intrinsic energies to candidate trajectories.
score_reasons: LLM 核心关键词强命中 (+0.8)

analysis_zh.summary_zh: 递归模型在推理和语言任务上有潜力，但其测试时扩展缺乏选择轨迹或确定递归深度的原则性标准。本文提出能量引导递归模型（ERM），利用Hopfield型记忆为候选轨迹分配内在能量，以指导候选选择并给出有效递归深度范围，还支持并行回火等采样方法。在推理任务上，ERM在数独、PPBench和迷宫上达到递归建模最佳准确率；在语言建模上，将RedPajama-V2困惑度降低1.74%，推理开销边际。
innovations_zh: 用Hopfield型记忆为候选轨迹分配内在能量
能量指导候选选择并给出有效递归深度范围
支持并行回火等采样方法改进探索
在推理与语言建模上验证能量引导框架
analysis_zh.significance: 该工作针对递归模型测试时扩展缺乏原则性选择标准的问题，提出能量引导框架，为轨迹选择和递归深度确定提供了新思路。其在多个推理任务和语言建模上的结果支持能量引导作为提升递归模型测试时扩展的实用框架，对相关领域有启发意义。
analysis_zh.limitations: 摘要仅报告了部分任务上的结果，未说明能量分配的具体机制、计算成本及在不同模型规模或任务分布上的泛化性。评测主要基于数独、PPBench、迷宫和RedPajama-V2困惑度，缺乏对更广泛推理任务和下游语言任务的验证。此外，能量引导的有效性可能依赖Hopfield型记忆的结构设计，其鲁棒性和理论保证尚不明确。
analysis_zh.potential: 未来可进一步探索能量引导在更多推理任务和语言生成任务中的适用性，研究能量函数的设计与理论性质，以及与其他测试时扩展方法的结合。长期看，若能量引导能稳定提升递归模型的测试时扩展效率，可能推动更可控、可解释的递归推理系统发展。

title: FTA-Mem: Fact-Time-Affect Anchored Memory for Low-Density Long-Term Dialogue
abstract: Long-term emotional-support agents require memory mechanisms for personalized understanding across sessions. However, emotional-support dialogue is often low-density: turns are incomplete, evidence is scattered, and user states evolve over time. Existing memory methods usually rely on fixed units, such as turn-level notes or session summaries, which may lose details or introduce redundant noise. We propose FTA-Mem, a structured memory framework for low-density long-term dialogue. FTA-Mem uses Boundary-preserving Window Segmentation (BWS) to form coherent situation fragments, and constructs Fact-Time-Affect Memory Units (FTA Units) that jointly encode factual content, temporal grounding, and affective context. Retrieved units are then synthesized into structured context for answer generation. Experiments on ES-MemEval and LoCoMo show that FTA-Mem improves overall long-term memory question answering across benchmarks with different information-density characteristics. On ES-MemEval, FTA-Mem achieves 0.3871 F1 and 0.6668 BERTScore. Further analysis shows that situation-level FTA construction better balances evidence preservation and construction cost than coarse session-level or overly fine-grained turn-pair construction, providing an effective granularity trade-off for long-term dialogue memory.
summary: Long-term emotional-support agents require memory mechanisms for personalized understanding across sessions. We propose FTA-Mem, a structured memory framework for low-density long-term dialogue.
innovations: We propose FTA-Mem, a structured memory framework for low-density long-term dialogue.

analysis_zh.summary_zh: 该论文针对长期情感支持对话中信息密度低、用户状态动态变化的问题，提出了一种名为FTA-Mem的结构化记忆框架。FTA-Mem通过边界保持窗口分割形成情境片段，并构建事实-时间-情感记忆单元，以联合编码事实内容、时间锚定和情感上下文。检索到的单元被合成为结构化上下文用于答案生成。在ES-MemEval和LoCoMo基准上的实验表明，FTA-Mem在长期记忆问答任务上取得了性能提升，并验证了情境级记忆构建在证据保留与构建成本之间的有效平衡。
innovations_zh: 提出边界保持窗口分割方法，形成连贯情境片段，适应低密度对话特性
设计事实-时间-情感三元记忆单元，联合编码多维度信息
验证情境级记忆粒度优于会话级和回合对级，提供粒度权衡方案
analysis_zh.significance: 该工作解决了长期情感支持对话中记忆机制因信息稀疏而失效的问题，为低密度对话场景提供了新的记忆构建思路。通过引入时间与情感锚定，增强了记忆的上下文相关性和可检索性，对长期对话系统的发展具有启发意义。
analysis_zh.limitations: 摘要仅报告了F1和BERTScore，缺乏与其他方法的显著性检验，性能提升的稳健性未知。实验仅在两个基准上验证，未涉及真实用户交互场景，泛化性有待考察。记忆单元构建依赖边界分割，对分割错误的敏感性未讨论。
analysis_zh.potential: 未来可探索将FTA-Mem应用于多模态对话或跨会话情感追踪，并优化分割算法以减少误差。长期价值在于为情感支持机器人提供更持久的个性化记忆，推动低密度对话场景下的记忆建模研究。

title: OmniAlign: A Unified Multilingual Aligner for Word and Sentence Alignment
abstract: Cross-lingual sequence alignment is fundamental for building and exploiting parallel corpora, spanning mappings from documents and sentences down to words and subwords. Existing tools, however, typically specialize in a single granularity, so practitioners often need separate systems for word- and sentence-level alignment---especially in multilingual and long-text settings. We present OmniAlign, a unified multilingual aligner that supports both word-level and sentence-level alignment with a single lightweight model. Built on an encoder-only backbone with strong long-context modeling, OmniAlign induces word alignments from contextualized token similarity matrices, and obtains document-level $m$--$n$ sentence alignments via sentence embeddings combined with dynamic programming. To balance fine-grained alignment accuracy and sentence-representation quality, we use a four-stage training pipeline: alignment-oriented continued pre-training, self-supervised learning, supervised fine-tuning on human annotations, and sentence-embedding distillation from a strong multilingual teacher. Experiments show that OmniAlign achieves highly competitive performance on both word- and sentence-alignment benchmarks and generalizes well to unseen language pairs. Surprisingly, later-stage supervised fine-tuning on short texts further improves alignment quality while retaining the long-context understanding acquired in earlier training, keeping the model robust on long-text word alignment. \normalsize {\color{blue}\textbf{Code}: https://github.com/MilkDargon/OmniAlign}\par {\color{blue}\textbf{Model}: https://huggingface.co/WPS-Qingqiu/OmniAlign}
summary: Cross-lingual sequence alignment is fundamental for building and exploiting parallel corpora, spanning mappings from documents and sentences down to words and subwords. We present OmniAlign, a unified multilingual aligner that supports both word-level and sentence-level alignment with a single lightweight model. Experiments show that OmniAlign achieves highly competitive performance on both word- and sentence-alignment benchmarks and generalizes well to unseen language pairs.
innovations: We present OmniAlign, a unified multilingual aligner that supports both word-level and sentence-level alignment with a single lightweight model.

analysis_zh.summary_zh: 该论文提出了OmniAlign，一个统一的轻量级多语言对齐模型，同时支持词级和句级对齐。模型基于编码器架构，通过上下文词元相似度矩阵生成词对齐，并结合句子嵌入与动态规划实现文档级m-n句对齐。采用四阶段训练流程（对齐导向的持续预训练、自监督学习、人工标注监督微调、教师模型蒸馏），在词级和句级对齐基准上表现优异，并泛化到未见语言对。
innovations_zh: 统一支持词级和句级对齐的单一轻量模型
四阶段训练流程平衡细粒度对齐与句子表示质量
利用动态规划实现文档级m-n句对齐
analysis_zh.significance: 该工作解决了现有工具仅支持单一粒度对齐的问题，为多语言和长文本场景提供了统一解决方案。其四阶段训练方法展示了监督微调对长文本对齐的正面影响，为后续对齐模型设计提供了新思路。
analysis_zh.limitations: 摘要未提供具体评测数据集和基线对比细节，难以全面评估性能优势。实验仅提及基准和泛化性，未讨论模型在极端长文本或低资源语言上的表现。
analysis_zh.potential: 未来可探索将OmniAlign扩展到更多语言和领域，并研究其与机器翻译、跨语言信息检索等任务的集成。长期看，统一对齐模型有望简化多语言处理流程，推动跨语言NLP应用发展。

title: CIPHER: Benchmarking Cross-record Inference over Privacy-Hardened Evidence Records
abstract: Reasoning over privacy-constrained records requires combining structured attributes with evidence from free-text narratives. We introduce CIPHER (Cross-record Inference over Privacy-Hardened Evidence Records), a benchmark of expert-validated questions from consumer-finance, clinical, and law-enforcement records. The questions cover common tabular operations and include executable SQL supervision. We evaluate retrieval, prompting, table-specialist, and hybrid symbolic-neural systems under native redaction and surrogate-based evidence restoration. All system families exhibit substantial failures even when supporting records are provided. Most errors arise from incorrect record selection and predicate interpretation rather than arithmetic execution. Privacy transformations have non-uniform effects, sometimes obscuring necessary evidence and sometimes reducing distraction. CIPHER provides a reproducible testbed for diagnosing these failures and assessing how transformations of sensitive text affect reasoning over hybrid records.
summary: Reasoning over privacy-constrained records requires combining structured attributes with evidence from free-text narratives. We introduce CIPHER (Cross-record Inference over Privacy-Hardened Evidence Records), a benchmark of expert-validated questions from consumer-finance, clinical, and law-enforcement records.
innovations: We introduce CIPHER (Cross-record Inference over Privacy-Hardened Evidence Records), a benchmark of expert-validated questions from consumer-finance, clinical, and law-enforcement records.

analysis_zh.summary_zh: 该论文提出了CIPHER基准，用于评估在隐私保护记录上的跨记录推理能力，涵盖消费者金融、临床和执法领域，并包含专家验证的问题和SQL监督。研究比较了检索、提示、表格专家及混合符号-神经等系统，在原始脱敏和替代证据恢复条件下进行测试。结果显示所有系统都存在显著失败，主要源于记录选择和谓词解释错误，而非算术执行问题。隐私变换的影响不均匀，有时掩盖必要证据，有时减少干扰。
innovations_zh: 首个跨领域隐私记录推理基准，含专家验证问题
提供SQL监督，支持可复现的系统诊断与评估
系统分析隐私变换对推理性能的非均匀影响
analysis_zh.significance: 该工作填补了隐私约束下混合记录推理评估的空白，为开发更鲁棒的推理系统提供了标准化测试平台。其发现有助于指导隐私保护与推理性能之间的权衡设计，推动符号与神经方法的融合。
analysis_zh.limitations: 摘要未提供具体性能数字或错误类型分布，难以量化各系统差距。评测基于特定领域和变换方式，可能限制结论的普遍性。未提及与真实世界部署场景的差异，如数据分布偏移或对抗性隐私攻击。
analysis_zh.potential: 未来可扩展至更多领域和隐私变换类型，并探索自适应证据恢复策略。该基准可促进开发更精准的记录选择与谓词理解模型，并推动隐私保护推理的理论研究。长期看，有望成为隐私计算与NLP交叉领域的标准评测工具。

title: PhaseShift: Topology-Aware Data Harmonization and Model Consolidation Across Signalized Intersections
abstract: Learned traffic-behavior models are commonly trained separately for each intersection, creating model portfolios that cannot share evidence across sites. We present PhaseShift, a topology-aware framework that harmonizes heterogeneous roadside trajectories into a shared actor-centric representation and trains one reusable backbone. Ego-relative coordinates, trajectory-induced movement paths, normalized signal context, and variable-cardinality interaction tokens remove site conventions while preserving behaviorally relevant topology. The backbone supports pooled operation, zero-shot at a held-out intersection, and low-data adaptation. We evaluate five intersections in two Florida regions on balanced field data, 100k training windows and equal-sized test sets per site under a replay-conditioned, best-of-sampled-trajectory protocol. At 10s, one pooled model lowers both minADE and minFDE relative to trained local models at all five sites, with median reductions of 36.8% and 22.0%. Leave-one-intersection-out deployment, including one cross-region fold, beats local training on both 10-s metrics at four of five sites, although short-horizon performance is less uniform. Fine-tuning with 1,000 target update windows improves on zero-shot at three sites and is the strongest regime at one. At site 7, every cross-site mixture sharply lowers long-horizon error under a fixed 100k-window budget; test-likelihood gains argue against a best-of-sample dispersion-only explanation. Local models fall behind calibrated IDM at the two highest-flow sites after long autoregressive rollouts; pretrained-backbone regimes do not. Within this five-site evaluation, PhaseShift demonstrates consolidation across heterogeneous physical control settings while identifying sites that still require adaptation. The protocol measures conditional single-vehicle generation under replayed context, not closed-loop traffic simulation.
summary: Learned traffic-behavior models are commonly trained separately for each intersection, creating model portfolios that cannot share evidence across sites. We present PhaseShift, a topology-aware framework that harmonizes heterogeneous roadside trajectories into a shared actor-centric representation and trains one reusable backbone.
innovations: We present PhaseShift, a topology-aware framework that harmonizes heterogeneous roadside trajectories into a shared actor-centric representation and trains one reusable backbone.

analysis_zh.summary_zh: 该论文提出PhaseShift框架，通过拓扑感知的数据协调和模型整合，将不同路口的异构轨迹数据统一为共享的演员中心表示，并训练一个可复用的骨干模型。在佛罗里达两个地区的五个路口上，该模型在10秒预测中显著优于本地训练模型，中位minADE和minFDE分别降低36.8%和22.0%，并在留一交叉路口测试中多数路口表现更优。此外，少量数据微调可进一步提升性能，但短时预测和部分路口仍需适应。
innovations_zh: 提出拓扑感知的跨路口数据协调方法，统一异构轨迹表示
训练单一可复用骨干模型，支持池化操作和零样本迁移
引入重放条件下的最佳采样轨迹评估协议
analysis_zh.significance: 该工作解决了交通行为模型跨路口泛化难的问题，通过共享表示和模型整合减少了对每个路口单独训练的需求，提高了数据利用效率和模型部署效率。其方法为智能交通系统中的行为预测提供了可扩展的解决方案，并展示了在异构控制场景下模型整合的可行性。
analysis_zh.limitations: 摘要仅基于五个路口的评估，样本量有限，且未提供跨更多区域或极端场景的验证。评估协议限定为条件单车辆生成，不涉及闭环交通模拟，因此对实际交通流动态交互的适用性未知。此外，短时预测性能不一致，且部分路口仍需微调，表明模型泛化能力仍有局限。
analysis_zh.potential: 未来可扩展至更多路口和城市，验证框架在大规模异构场景下的鲁棒性。可探索将闭环模拟纳入评估，以更全面衡量模型在真实交通控制中的表现。长期来看，该框架有望成为智能交通系统统一行为预测的基础，支持跨区域模型共享和持续学习。

title: Custom Named Entity Recognition and Topic Classification for Global Health Publications
abstract: How should natural language processing models be selected and adapted for global health literature in environments where annotated data and computational resources are limited? This thesis investigates these challenges through experiments on semantic tag discovery, named entity recognition (NER), and multi-label topic classification. First, skip-gram word2vec models trained on progressively larger specialized corpora are compared with BioWordVec to assess how corpus size and domain context influence tag discovery. Vocabulary coverage and qualitative evaluation indicate that broader coverage does not necessarily yield more useful domain-specific associations. The analysis then turns to entity extraction, comparing convolutional spaCy models with a RoBERTa-based transformer on 1,000 annotated sentences. Under a lenient scoring protocol, the transformer achieves 0.80 micro-F1 versus 0.65-0.69 for convolutional models, but takes 82 seconds rather than 5-6 seconds. This trade-off motivates fine-tuning convolutional models and integrating a disease recognizer that achieves 81.33% test F1 on the NCBI Disease Corpus. Combined with PDF preprocessing, entity filtering, and MeSH enrichment, the resulting pipeline supports document-level indexing. To complement entity extraction with thematic annotation, MiniLM-based few-shot classification is compared with BART-MNLI zero-shot inference across 50 topics and 1,000 handcrafted test sentences. BART-MNLI achieves 95.2% single-label accuracy versus 59%; reported multi-label accuracies are 88% and 32% under partly manual assessment. However, its higher inference cost limits practical integration. The results show where domain specialization and lightweight adaptation offer practical value, and where transformer accuracy justifies higher inference costs, providing an empirical basis for building knowledge systems under resource constraints.
summary: How should natural language processing models be selected and adapted for global health literature in environments where annotated data and computational resources are limited? The results show where domain specialization and lightweight adaptation offer practical value, and where transformer accuracy justifies higher inference costs, providing an empirical basis for building knowledge systems under resource constraints.
innovations: First, skip-gram word2vec models trained on progressively larger specialized corpora are compared with BioWordVec to assess how corpus size and domain context influence tag discovery.

analysis_zh.summary_zh: 该论文面向标注数据和计算资源有限的全球健康文献场景，研究如何选择和适配自然语言处理模型。方法上依次开展语义标签发现、命名实体识别和多标签主题分类实验：比较不同规模专用语料训练的skip-gram word2vec与BioWordVec，比较卷积spaCy模型与RoBERTa在1000句标注数据上的表现，并对比MiniLM少样本分类与BART-MNLI零样本推理。结果显示，语料覆盖更广未必带来更有用的领域关联；宽松评分下Transformer取得0.80 micro-F1，高于卷积模型的0.65-0.69，但推理耗时82秒对5-6秒；BART-MNLI单标签准确率达95.2%，远高于59%，但推理成本更高。
innovations_zh: 在全球健康低资源场景下系统比较词向量、NER与主题分类模型
结合疾病识别器、PDF预处理、实体过滤与MeSH增强构建索引流程
对比少样本MiniLM与零样本BART-MNLI在50个主题上的分类效果
analysis_zh.significance: 研究意义：该工作针对全球健康文献在标注数据与算力受限条件下的模型选型与适配问题，提供了词向量、实体识别和主题分类三类任务的实证比较。其贡献在于揭示领域专门化与轻量适配的实用价值，以及Transformer精度提升与推理成本之间的权衡，为资源受限环境下构建知识系统提供经验依据。
analysis_zh.limitations: 研究不足之处：摘要仅给出有限实验设置，如NER仅基于1000句标注数据、主题分类基于1000句手工测试句，结论的泛化性尚不明确。多标签准确率部分依赖人工评估，评测口径可能影响可比性；同时未充分说明不同语料规模、领域和语言条件下的稳定性。
analysis_zh.potential: 未来研究潜力：可进一步探索在更低算力条件下保持Transformer精度的方法，如蒸馏、量化或更高效的少样本适配。还可扩展至更多全球健康子领域、语言和实体类型，并系统评估该流程在真实文档级索引与知识系统中的应用价值。

title: Conversational DNA: A Visual Language and Interactive Atlas of Human and AI Dialogue
abstract: What makes a conversation hold together when its participants speak across one another? Topic maps offer one view, but they leave the relationships between contributions difficult to inspect. We present Conversational DNA, a visual language and interactive atlas for exploring human and AI dialogue. Speaker strands preserve participation, communicative bases mark moves, and directed pairings connect responses to their targets. Adjustable helix geometry makes speaker switching, response distance, and contribution length visible. Across eight corpora containing 1.57 million source records, the atlas maps 151,489 indexed episodes and connects cohort comparison to source transcripts, local structural alignment, and recorded reply alternatives. On 189 held-out Molweni motif queries, adding target correspondence improves precision@5 from 58.8% to 77.2% for exact annotated structure. Case readings illustrate interleaved participation, delayed responses, and the influence of annotation coverage on apparent collection differences. The system supports a view of conversation as jointly organized activity, with visual patterns serving as starting points for examining evidence rather than substitutes for interpretation.
summary: What makes a conversation hold together when its participants speak across one another? We present Conversational DNA, a visual language and interactive atlas for exploring human and AI dialogue.
innovations: We present Conversational DNA, a visual language and interactive atlas for exploring human and AI dialogue.

analysis_zh.summary_zh: 该研究针对对话中话题地图难以呈现参与者贡献间关系的问题，提出了名为“Conversational DNA”的可视化语言与交互式图谱。系统通过说话者链、交际基和定向配对等设计，结合可调螺旋几何，展示说话者切换、响应距离和贡献长度。研究在八个语料库、157万条源记录上映射了151489个索引片段，并在189个Molweni动机查询上验证，加入目标对应后精确率@5从58.8%提升至77.2%。案例阅读揭示了交错参与、延迟响应及标注覆盖对集合差异的影响。
innovations_zh: 提出说话者链、交际基与定向配对构成的对话可视化语言
可调螺旋几何直观呈现说话者切换、响应距离与贡献长度
将队列比较与源转录、局部结构对齐及回复替代项连接
在Molweni查询上验证目标对应显著提升结构检索精度
analysis_zh.significance: 该工作将对话视为联合组织的活动，为分析人类与AI对话提供了可交互的结构化视图。其贡献在于把可视化模式作为检验证据的起点，而非替代解释，有助于研究者审视参与结构、响应关系与标注偏差。
analysis_zh.limitations: 摘要仅报告了Molweni上的精确率@5结果，未说明其他语料或任务的泛化性能。系统依赖已有标注与索引片段，标注覆盖可能影响集合差异的呈现。此外，可视化模式与解释之间的因果或定量关联未在摘要中充分展开。
analysis_zh.potential: 未来可扩展至更多语言、多模态及实时对话场景，并检验目标对应机制在不同结构检索任务中的稳健性。长期价值在于支持可解释的对话分析工具，帮助研究者与开发者诊断AI对话系统的参与与响应模式。

title: An Open Recipe for IMO Gold: Training Nemotron for Olympiad Mathematics
abstract: We study how model post-training and test-time inference design affect natural-language proof generation for hard olympiad mathematics. Starting from Nemotron 3 Ultra, we train two specialist checkpoints using supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and evaluate checkpoint choice, verification, and refinement. Based on these findings, we present an open-model test-time-compute pipeline. The system operates entirely in natural language, with no formal prover, external tools, or internet access. Three Nemotron 3 Ultra checkpoints - the general-availability model and two post-trained specialists - power an iterative search that generates, verifies, and refines candidate proofs; a separate high-compute stage then selects each final submission. The system scored 30 out of 42 points at IMO 2026, reaching the gold-medal threshold. We release the two post-trained checkpoints as well as the training data, the training and inference code, the submitted solutions, and Nemotron-IMO-Bench, a new benchmark of 200 novel olympiad-level problems.
summary: We study how model post-training and test-time inference design affect natural-language proof generation for hard olympiad mathematics. Based on these findings, we present an open-model test-time-compute pipeline.
innovations: Based on these findings, we present an open-model test-time-compute pipeline.

We release the two post-trained checkpoints as well as the training data, the training and inference code, the submitted solutions, and Nemotron-IMO-Bench, a new benchmark of 200 novel olympiad-level problems.

analysis_zh.summary_zh: 该研究探讨模型后训练与测试时推理设计对高难度奥数自然语言证明生成的影响。作者以 Nemotron 3 Ultra 为基座，通过监督微调和强化学习训练出两个专家检查点，并系统评估检查点选择、验证与精炼策略。基于此提出一个完全基于自然语言、不依赖形式化证明器、外部工具或互联网的测试时计算流水线，由三个检查点驱动迭代搜索生成、验证和精炼候选证明，再由独立高算力阶段选出最终提交。该系统在 IMO 2026 上获得 42 分中的 30 分，达到金牌阈值，并开源了检查点、训练数据、代码、提交解答及包含 200 道新题的 Nemotron-IMO-Bench 基准。
innovations_zh: 提出完全自然语言、无需形式化证明器或外部工具的奥数证明测试时计算流水线
结合通用模型与两个后训练专家检查点进行迭代生成、验证与精炼
引入独立高算力选择阶段决定最终提交，提升证明质量
开源检查点、训练数据、代码、解答及 200 题新基准 Nemotron-IMO-Bench
analysis_zh.significance: 该工作展示了通过后训练与测试时推理设计，通用大模型可在高难度奥数自然语言证明任务上达到 IMO 金牌水平，且无需形式化系统或外部工具。其开源模型、数据、代码与基准为奥数推理研究提供了可复现的开放配方，有助于推动自然语言数学证明生成领域的发展。
analysis_zh.limitations: 摘要仅报告 IMO 2026 的单一竞赛得分，未说明在其他奥数竞赛或分布外问题上的泛化表现。系统依赖高算力测试时搜索与独立选择阶段，实际推理成本与效率未予披露。此外，评估以最终得分为主，对证明正确性、验证可靠性和精炼效果的细粒度分析有限。
analysis_zh.potential: 未来可探索将该开放配方迁移至其他数学领域或更广泛的自然语言推理任务，并研究降低测试时计算成本的方法。Nemotron-IMO-Bench 可作为持续评测基准，推动对证明验证、精炼与选择机制的深入研究，长期有望促进无需形式化工具的高可信数学推理系统发展。

title: QuantumPhaseNet: A Gauge-Covariant Geometric and Quantum-Spectral Theory of Semantic Concept Hierarchies with Prototype Validation of a Classical Quantum-Inspired Model
abstract: We present QuantumPhaseNet, a gauge-covariant geometric and quantum-spectral extension of Transformer representations. Context-dependent semantic states are modeled as complex amplitudes; a covariant phase rate induces a semantic wavelength used as a proxy for conceptual scale; and low-frequency graph modes define a document-level discourse direction. The theoretical part establishes local gauge invariance, unitarity of the quantum block, boundedness and conditional stability of WavePhase Attention, and a calibratable hallucination-risk formulation. We also implemented a fully offline Validation Studio for the classical quantum-inspired pipeline in Section 14.1 and evaluated the five research questions in Section 16.1 on its built-in synthetic setting (n=240, observation noise 0.22, circuit noise 0.08, five seeds). RQ1 yielded a wavelength-hierarchy Spearman correlation of 0.852 versus 0.707 for the baseline, 87.3% direction accuracy, and AUC 0.953. RQ2 achieved discourse alignment 0.933 versus 0.589 and 41.2 versus 16.2 paragraphs before drift. RQ3 achieved AUROC 0.881 versus cosine 0.765 and phase-shuffle 0.536. RQ4 achieved error-detection AUROC 0.854 versus entropy 0.634, with Brier 0.150 and ECE 0.098. RQ5 did not show quantum advantage: target probability and end-to-end cost efficiency were 25.5% and 0.107, compared with 70.7% and 0.707 for the Chebyshev classical approximation. These results provide initial synthetic evidence for the classical quantum-inspired components, but not external validity or unconditional quantum speedup.
comment: [PAGES] pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Extends arXiv:2602.14419 (WavePhaseNet). Includes prototype validation with an offline Validation Studio; RQ5 reports a negative result for quantum advantage
summary: We present QuantumPhaseNet, a gauge-covariant geometric and quantum-spectral extension of Transformer representations.
innovations: We present QuantumPhaseNet, a gauge-covariant geometric and quantum-spectral extension of Transformer representations.

analysis_zh.summary_zh: 该论文提出QuantumPhaseNet，一种规范协变的几何与量子谱扩展的Transformer表示方法，将上下文相关语义状态建模为复振幅，并引入语义波长和文档级话语方向。理论部分证明了局部规范不变性、量子块幺正性、WavePhase注意力有界性与条件稳定性，以及可校准的幻觉风险公式。在离线合成数据集（n=240）上评估了五个研究问题，RQ1-RQ4显示优于基线，但RQ5未显示量子优势。
innovations_zh: 提出规范协变的量子谱语义表示，将语义状态建模为复振幅并引入语义波长
构建WavePhase注意力机制，并证明其有界性与条件稳定性
设计可校准的幻觉风险公式，并实现离线验证工作室
analysis_zh.significance: 该工作为Transformer表示提供了新的几何与量子谱视角，有助于理解语义概念层级和话语结构。通过合成实验初步验证了经典量子启发组件的有效性，为后续量子自然语言处理研究提供了理论框架和评估工具。
analysis_zh.limitations: 仅基于摘要，缺乏真实数据上的外部效度验证，所有结果均来自内置合成设置。RQ5未显示量子优势，且未与真实量子硬件对比，量子加速的结论尚不成立。
analysis_zh.potential: 未来可在真实语料上验证该方法的泛化能力，并探索量子硬件实现以检验量子优势。理论框架可扩展至多语言、多模态语义建模，以及幻觉检测等实际应用。

title: Detoxifying Toxic Communication: A Design Science Approach to Responsible AI
abstract: Toxic language in digital workplaces such as pejoratives, sarcasm, condescension, and subtle incivility can erode trust, morale, and collaboration. Existing moderation tools primarily delete or block harmful messages, disrupting communication and offering no constructive resolution. This study adopts a Design Science Research approach to create a responsible AI artifact that detects and detoxifies toxic communication. The artifact integrates fine-tuned transformer-based classifiers (DistilBERT, DistilRoBERTa) with a generative detoxification model (mT0-XL-Detox-ORPO) that rewrites toxic text into semantically equivalent, non-offensive paraphrases. Technical evaluation demonstrates high accuracy in toxicity detection and strong semantic preservation in rewritten messages, supporting conversation continuity while reinforcing respectful discourse. The paper contributes design principles for responsible AI moderation that prioritize meaning preservation and fairness.
comment: 10 pages. An updated version appears in the Proceedings of the 60th Hawaii International Conference on Systems Science (HICSS-60), Honolulu, HI, January 5-8, 2027
summary: Toxic language in digital workplaces such as pejoratives, sarcasm, condescension, and subtle incivility can erode trust, morale, and collaboration.
innovations: Toxic language in digital workplaces such as pejoratives, sarcasm, condescension, and subtle incivility can erode trust, morale, and collaboration.

analysis_zh.summary_zh: 本研究针对数字职场中的有毒语言（如贬损、讽刺等）侵蚀信任与合作的问题，采用设计科学研究方法，构建了一个负责任的人工智能系统。该系统结合微调的Transformer分类器（DistilBERT、DistilRoBERTa）与生成式去毒模型（mT0-XL-Detox-ORPO），在检测有毒文本的同时将其改写为语义等价且非冒犯的表述。技术评估显示，该系统在毒性检测准确性和语义保留方面表现良好，有助于维持对话连续性并促进尊重性交流。
innovations_zh: 提出检测与去毒一体化的负责任AI审核框架，超越传统删除或屏蔽方式
融合轻量级分类器与生成式去毒模型，兼顾准确性与语义保留
提炼出以意义保留和公平为核心的设计原则，指导AI审核系统开发
analysis_zh.significance: 该工作解决了现有内容审核工具仅删除或屏蔽有害信息、缺乏建设性解决方案的问题，为数字职场提供了一种促进对话连续性和尊重性交流的新途径。其提出的设计原则为负责任AI在内容审核领域的应用提供了理论指导和实践参考，有助于推动更公平、更注重语义保留的AI系统设计。
analysis_zh.limitations: 摘要仅报告了技术评估结果，缺乏在真实职场环境中的用户研究或部署效果验证，其实际可用性和社会影响尚不明确。此外，评估可能未充分覆盖不同语境、文化背景或语言变体下的毒性检测与改写效果，泛化能力有待进一步检验。
analysis_zh.potential: 未来研究可探索将该系统集成到实际职场沟通平台，进行纵向现场实验以评估其对团队氛围和协作的长期影响。同时，可扩展至更多语言和更细粒度的毒性类型（如隐性偏见），并引入用户反馈机制持续优化模型，推动负责任AI在内容审核领域的深入应用。

title: The Attention Triangle in Audio-Video Models
abstract: Audio-video diffusion models rely on cross-modal attention to coordinate text, sound, and visual content, yet this same mechanism can introduce subtle and systematic semantic leakage. We study these models by probing and analyzing the ``attention triangle,'' comprising the three cross-attention edges connecting the text, audio, and video streams, and examine how semantic information is routed across modalities during generation. Our analysis reveals that routing along the audio-video edge is bidirectional: audio can influence video generation, while video can influence audio generation. This edge is shaped by biases encoded in the model's parameters and emerges as a major contributor to leakage: when prompts are in tension with learned priors, cross-modal interactions may override the intended conditioning and reroute semantics toward visually canonical but incorrect outcomes. These effects suggest that semantic artifacts arise not merely from attention spreading beyond its intended target, but from structured, bias-driven interactions along specific pathways. Building on this perspective, we extract attention-derived signals that expose how semantics are distributed and grounded across modalities, and use them as a diagnostic tool to both analyze and deliberately incur leakage under controlled conditions. This enables us to probe the internal dynamics of cross-modal routing and isolate the role of individual interactions. We further leverage these signals to guide inference-time interventions that encourage more consistent cross-modal alignment. Extensive experiments support our analysis and demonstrate improved semantic grounding while preserving generation quality.
summary: Audio-video diffusion models rely on cross-modal attention to coordinate text, sound, and visual content, yet this same mechanism can introduce subtle and systematic semantic leakage. Extensive experiments support our analysis and demonstrate improved semantic grounding while preserving generation quality.
innovations: Audio-video diffusion models rely on cross-modal attention to coordinate text, sound, and visual content, yet this same mechanism can introduce subtle and systematic semantic leakage.

analysis_zh.summary_zh: 该论文研究音视频扩散模型中的跨模态注意力机制，提出“注意力三角”框架，分析文本、音频、视频三者间的跨注意力交互。通过探测发现音视频边是双向的，且受模型参数偏见影响，导致语义泄漏和错误生成。作者提取注意力信号作为诊断工具，并用于引导推理时干预，以改善跨模态对齐和语义接地，实验验证了方法的有效性。
innovations_zh: 提出注意力三角概念，系统分析音视频扩散模型中跨模态语义路由机制
揭示音视频边双向影响及偏见驱动的语义泄漏路径
利用注意力信号进行诊断和可控泄漏，并指导推理时干预
analysis_zh.significance: 该工作揭示了跨模态扩散模型中语义泄漏的结构性成因，而非简单注意力扩散，为理解模型内部动态提供了新视角。其诊断工具和干预方法有助于提升生成内容的语义一致性，对多模态生成领域具有方法论贡献。
analysis_zh.limitations: 摘要未提供具体实验规模或数据集细节，难以评估方法的泛化性。诊断和干预可能依赖特定模型架构，对其他类型多模态模型的适用性未知。仅基于摘要，无法判断生成质量保持的具体程度和计算成本。
analysis_zh.potential: 未来可探索将注意力三角诊断用于其他多模态任务（如文本-图像-语音），并发展更自动化的干预策略。长期看，该框架有助于构建更可控、更鲁棒的多模态生成系统，减少偏见导致的语义漂移。

title: MMLA: Memory-Mediated Learning Architecture for Predictive Dual-State Adaptation
abstract: Memory-Mediated Learning Architecture (MMLA) separates slow base parameters theta, a bounded numerical policy carrier Phi, and a bounded authoritative memory M. Predictive Dual-State Adaptation (PDSA) lets feedback update Phi while one problem remains active and lets a trusted lifecycle atomically commit one typed row or exact NULL. Later reasoning may read both states, but their writers, resets, rollback domains, and ledgers remain distinct. Realized futures supervise values only during training; deployment is causal and future-blind. We give conditional theory and falsifiable contracts for reasoning-time updates, completed-segment consolidation, predictive admission, authoritative memory, and dual-state attribution. Assumptions, counterexamples, capacity and cost ledgers, recovery duties, and identifying experiments are explicit; these are not implementation guarantees. Controlled studies show exact lifecycle execution on 300/300 held-out records for each of three seeds, calibrated retrieval gains over frozen-hidden dense and BM25 baselines, and exact typed anchor-filler transport on 240/240 held-out records per seed. These validate restricted components, not natural-language memory management or complete PDSA. Post-training studies retain positive and negative evidence. Later protocols obtain restricted readout progress, but a nine-trajectory comparison finds that matched latent readout, a full-width bridge, and bridge plus frozen text-teacher alignment all fail continuous-event qualification across both task families. A separately adapted text reference and restoration checks pass. At the September 13, 2026 evidence cutoff, no strict policy-only reasoning-time-training effect, predictive-admission oracle margin, learned future-blind admission policy, or policy-by-memory factorial advantage is established.
comment: 222 pages, 64 figures, 81 tables. Substantially expanded v4: updated architecture terminology; five integrated theory parts; additional post-training readout studies, including negative results; corrected proofs and causal statements; expanded related work. Project: https://github.com/MMLA-org/mmla-memory
summary: Memory-Mediated Learning Architecture (MMLA) separates slow base parameters theta, a bounded numerical policy carrier Phi, and a bounded authoritative memory M.
innovations: Memory-Mediated Learning Architecture (MMLA) separates slow base parameters theta, a bounded numerical policy carrier Phi, and a bounded authoritative memory M.

analysis_zh.summary_zh: 该论文提出记忆中介学习架构（MMLA），将慢速基础参数θ、有界数值策略载体Φ与有界权威记忆M分离，并引入预测性双态适应（PDSA），使反馈可在问题活跃期间更新Φ，同时由可信生命周期原子化提交类型化行或精确NULL。训练时由真实未来监督数值，部署时保持因果且未来盲。受控实验在三个随机种子上对300/300条留出记录实现精确生命周期执行，在检索上优于冻结隐藏稠密与BM25基线，并在240/240条留出记录上实现精确类型化锚填充传输；但截至2026年9月13日，严格策略仅推理时训练效应、预测准入oracle裕度、学习到的未来盲准入策略及策略-记忆因子优势均未确立。
innovations_zh: 分离慢速基础参数、有界策略载体与有界权威记忆，并保持写入、重置、回滚域与账本独立
提出预测性双态适应，允许活跃问题期间更新策略载体并由可信生命周期原子提交
给出推理时更新、完成段巩固、预测准入与双态归因的条件理论与可证伪契约
analysis_zh.significance: 该工作试图在保持部署因果性与未来盲的前提下，为推理时适应与权威记忆管理提供可检验的架构契约与账本机制。其贡献在于将记忆、策略与基础参数的责任边界显式化，并通过受控实验验证受限组件，为后续自然语言记忆管理与完整PDSA研究提供可证伪的基准。
analysis_zh.limitations: 摘要明确这些结果仅验证受限组件，不构成自然语言记忆管理或完整PDSA的实现保证。九轨迹比较显示匹配潜在读出、全宽桥接及桥接加冻结文本教师对齐均未通过连续事件资格，且严格策略仅推理时训练效应、预测准入oracle裕度、学习到的未来盲准入策略与策略-记忆因子优势均未确立。
analysis_zh.potential: 未来可沿严格策略仅推理时训练效应、学习到的未来盲准入策略及策略-记忆因子优势等未确立方向推进。若能在自然语言记忆管理与完整PDSA上复现受限组件的精确性，该架构可能为因果部署下的持续适应提供可审计的长期框架。

title: Shared-Prefix KV Reuse Across Standard LoRA Adapters: Quality and Serving Tradeoffs
abstract: A common small-model deployment runs one shared backbone with several LoRA specialists that answer over the same context. Serving them naively re-prefills that shared context once per specialist. We study a narrow, practical question: for already-trained standard LoRA adapters -- not adapters retrained for cache compatibility -- how much task quality is preserved if the backbone's prefill KV cache is computed once and reused across specialists, and what does that buy in serving cost? On a Qwen3-1.7B backbone with two adapters (extractive QA on HotpotQA, arithmetic reasoning on GSM8K), we sweep the boundary at which the specialist takes over from the reused base cache and measure paired quality differences and serving cost. Full-prefix reuse had the lowest prefill cost and a small quality difference on held-out GSM8K (Delta = -4.6 EM at a 160-token budget; -3.0 at 320 tokens; -0.8 under a second training seed -- all favoring native, only the first excluding zero, and the magnitude not consistent). Partial recomputation provided no demonstrated advantage. Neither quality equivalence nor a general boundary-selection rule is established. We also report a closed-form ridge KV translator that did not beat direct reuse, and specialist-dependence contrasts whose intervals all include zero. The measured serving benefit is warm-cache time-to-first-token, which grows with context (~16x at 8K); two-branch peak memory was only 12% lower and, on inspection, the prefix was never physically shared across branches -- this implementation reuses KV values but copies their storage, so shared-cache memory savings are not achieved.
summary: A common small-model deployment runs one shared backbone with several LoRA specialists that answer over the same context.
innovations: Full-prefix reuse had the lowest prefill cost and a small quality difference on held-out GSM8K (Delta = -4.6 EM at a 160-token budget; -3.0 at 320 tokens; -0.8 under a second training seed -- all favoring native, only the first excluding zero, and the magnitude not consistent).

analysis_zh.summary_zh: 该研究关注已训练好的标准LoRA适配器在共享同一骨干模型与上下文时的服务效率问题，即是否可以将骨干的预填充KV缓存计算一次并复用于多个专家适配器。作者在Qwen3-1.7B骨干上使用两个适配器（HotpotQA抽取式问答和GSM8K算术推理），通过扫描专家接管复用基础缓存的边界，测量配对质量差异与服务成本。结果显示全前缀复用预填充成本最低，在GSM8K上质量差异较小但不稳定（不同预算和训练种子下Delta为-4.6、-3.0、-0.8 EM），部分重计算未展现优势，且实现中KV值被复制而非物理共享，因此未实现共享缓存的内存节省。
innovations_zh: 研究标准LoRA适配器间共享预填充KV缓存的实用问题
在Qwen3-1.7B上量化复用边界对质量与服务成本的影响
报告闭式岭回归KV翻译器未优于直接复用
揭示实现中KV存储被复制而非共享的内存局限
analysis_zh.significance: 该工作针对多LoRA专家共享上下文时重复预填充的计算浪费问题，探索了无需重新训练适配器即可复用KV缓存的可行性。其贡献在于提供了初步的实证数据，表明全前缀复用可降低预填充成本且质量损失有限，同时指出了实现层面的内存共享障碍，为后续高效多适配器服务系统设计提供了参考。
analysis_zh.limitations: 研究仅基于单一骨干模型和两个特定任务适配器，结论的普适性有限。质量差异的幅度不一致且部分置信区间包含零，未能确立质量等价性或通用的边界选择规则。此外，实现中KV存储被复制而非物理共享，导致共享缓存的内存节省未实现，且部分重计算和KV翻译器均未展现优势。
analysis_zh.potential: 未来可扩展至更多骨干模型、适配器类型和任务，以验证复用策略的通用性。可探索真正实现KV存储物理共享的工程方案，以兑现内存节省潜力。长期价值在于为多专家小模型部署提供无需重训练的高效服务范式，但需进一步建立质量与成本的权衡准则。

title: MIST: Multimodal Survival Prediction with Genomic-Guided Histology Attention
abstract: Multimodal survival models can combine complementary prognostic information from whole-slide images and genomic profiles, but effective fusion remains challenging amid external cohort shift and computational complexity. To address these challenges, we propose MIST, multimodal survival prediction with genomic-guided histology attention. MIST represents genomic features as tokens and allows them to query compact foundation-model-derived histology context tokens before survival prediction. This design enriches molecular information with histology context rather than merging separately encoded modalities only at the final stage. Training combines discrete-time survival prediction with genomic feature masking, WSI dropout, and paired WSI-genomics contrastive alignment. Across four external evaluations in colon, renal, lung, and glioblastoma cohorts, MIST improves external C-index over standard fusion baselines in the primary comparisons. These results support genomic-guided histology attention as a compact and effective strategy for multimodal oncology outcome prediction. Our code is available at https://github.com/samiyavuuz/MIST .
comment: Accepted at the COMPAYL 2026 Workshop on Computational Pathology and Multimodal Data at MICCAI 2026. 11 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables
summary: Multimodal survival models can combine complementary prognostic information from whole-slide images and genomic profiles, but effective fusion remains challenging amid external cohort shift and computational complexity. To address these challenges, we propose MIST, multimodal survival prediction with genomic-guided histology attention.
innovations: To address these challenges, we propose MIST, multimodal survival prediction with genomic-guided histology attention.

analysis_zh.summary_zh: 多模态生存模型可融合全切片图像与基因组信息，但外部队列偏移和计算复杂度使有效融合仍具挑战。作者提出MIST，将基因组特征表示为token，在生存预测前查询紧凑的基础模型衍生组织学上下文token，从而以组织学上下文丰富分子信息。训练结合离散时间生存预测、基因组特征掩蔽、WSI丢弃和配对WSI-基因组对比对齐。在结肠、肾、肺和胶质母细胞瘤四个外部评估中，MIST在主要比较中较标准融合基线提升了外部C-index。
innovations_zh: 以基因组token查询组织学上下文token，而非仅在最终阶段融合
训练结合离散时间生存预测与基因组掩蔽、WSI丢弃
引入配对WSI-基因组对比对齐以增强跨模态表征
analysis_zh.significance: 该工作针对多模态肿瘤生存预测中外部队列偏移与计算复杂度问题，提出基因组引导的组织学注意力融合策略。其贡献在于将融合前移至组织学上下文查询阶段，并在多个外部队列上验证了相对标准融合基线的C-index提升，为紧凑有效的多模态预后预测提供了启发。
analysis_zh.limitations: 摘要仅报告了外部C-index相对标准融合基线的提升，未给出具体数值、统计显著性、消融或校准等细节。评估限于结肠、肾、肺和胶质母细胞瘤四个队列，对其他癌种、数据模态缺失或不同队列偏移程度的泛化性尚不明确。此外，方法依赖基础模型衍生的组织学token与基因组特征，其计算与数据需求未在摘要中说明。
analysis_zh.potential: 未来可进一步探索基因组引导注意力在其他癌种与多模态组合中的适用性，并系统分析各训练组件对性能与鲁棒性的贡献。长期看，该紧凑融合思路有望推动多模态肿瘤预后模型在外部队列中的可迁移性与临床转化研究。

title: Comparing Latent Concept Formation in State Space Models and Transformers via Sparse Autoencoders
abstract: The quadratic scaling of Transformer self-attention has driven the adoption of sub-quadratic Selective State Space Models (SSMs) like Mamba, which compress past context into a fixed-size recurrent hidden state. This strict informational bottleneck raises a foundational question for mechanistic interpretability: do SSMs and Transformers learn fundamentally distinct latent representations? In this work, we employ Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to conduct a large-scale, feature-level correspondence analysis between Mamba-130m and Pythia-70m over a 10-million token corpus. Contrary to hypotheses predicting widespread architectural divergence, we find no evidence of systematic representational divergence between architectures: across the observed Jaccard distribution, 99.98% of Mamba features cluster toward the upper alignment boundary, providing preliminary feature-level support for the Universality Hypothesis. We further identify and qualitatively characterize this microscopic fraction (0.02%) of diverging features, finding patterns consistent with the hypothesis that the recurrent bottleneck selectively limits the parsing of rigid syntax rather than broad semantic ontology. We demonstrate that while Pythia's unconstrained attention permits the monosemantic decomposition of distinct formatting edge-cases, Mamba is forced to compress unrelated syntactical anomalies into polysemantic "junk drawer" neurons to preserve state capacity. Collectively, these results suggest that architectural routing mechanisms may have negligible impact on core semantic understanding, with representational divergence confined to extreme structural margins.
summary: The quadratic scaling of Transformer self-attention has driven the adoption of sub-quadratic Selective State Space Models (SSMs) like Mamba, which compress past context into a fixed-size recurrent hidden state. In this work, we employ Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to conduct a large-scale, feature-level correspondence analysis between Mamba-130m and Pythia-70m over a 10-million token corpus. We demonstrate that while Pythia's unconstrained attention permits the monosemantic decomposition of distinct formatting edge-cases, Mamba is forced to compress unrelated syntactical anomalies into polysemantic "junk drawer" neurons to preserve state capacity.
innovations: The quadratic scaling of Transformer self-attention has driven the adoption of sub-quadratic Selective State Space Models (SSMs) like Mamba, which compress past context into a fixed-size recurrent hidden state.

analysis_zh.summary_zh: 该研究关注选择性状态空间模型（如Mamba）与Transformer在潜在表示上是否存在本质差异，因为前者将历史上下文压缩到固定大小的循环隐状态中。作者使用稀疏自编码器，在1000万token语料上对Mamba-130m和Pythia-70m进行大规模特征级对应分析。结果显示，99.98%的Mamba特征落在对齐上界附近，没有证据支持系统性的表示分歧，初步支持通用性假设。仅0.02%的分歧特征与循环瓶颈限制刚性句法解析、并迫使无关句法异常被压缩为多义“杂物抽屉”神经元有关。
innovations_zh: 用稀疏自编码器做Mamba与Transformer的大规模特征级对应分析
在1000万token语料上量化特征对齐与分歧比例
发现分歧集中于刚性句法而非广泛语义本体
提出循环瓶颈导致多义“杂物抽屉”神经元的解释
analysis_zh.significance: 该工作直面状态空间模型与Transformer是否学习根本不同潜在表示这一机制可解释性问题，并通过特征级证据表明架构路由机制对核心语义理解的影响可能很小。它为通用性假设提供了初步支持，并将表示分歧定位在极端结构边缘，有助于理解不同架构在可解释性上的共性与差异。
analysis_zh.limitations: 结论主要基于Mamba-130m与Pythia-70m在1000万token语料上的稀疏自编码器分析，模型规模和语料范围有限，不能直接外推到更大模型或更多任务。摘要未说明评测任务、下游性能或因果干预，因此特征对齐与语义理解之间的因果关系仍不确定。0.02%分歧特征的定性刻画也可能受稀疏自编码器超参数和特征识别方法影响。
analysis_zh.potential: 未来可扩展到更大规模模型、更多架构家族和多样化语料，检验通用性假设是否稳健成立。可结合因果干预或下游任务，验证特征对齐是否真正对应语义功能等价。还可深入研究循环瓶颈如何影响句法解析，并探索缓解多义“杂物抽屉”神经元、提升状态空间模型可解释性的方法。

title: FlashLoop: Fast and Memory-Efficient Looped Transformers via Lazy Updates
abstract: Looped Transformers have attracted substantial attention as a parameter-efficient approach to increasing computational depth through repeated application of shared Transformer blocks. However, their practical advantages over conventional Transformers remain under debate: each additional loop incurs another Transformer pass and requires caching another set of KV states, causing inference FLOPs and KV-cache memory to grow continuously with loop depth. This overhead becomes particularly severe at large loop counts and long context, preventing the parameter efficiency of Looped Transformers from translating into practical inference efficiency. In this paper, we find that much of the additional computation and storage introduced by looping is redundant. As recurrence proceeds, state changes become increasingly concentrated on a small subset of tokens; attention-output differences are dominated by a sparse and stable subset of key columns; and KV residuals between adjacent loops become progressively more amenable to low-bit quantization. Building on these observations, we introduce FlashLoop, a training-free inference framework that reduces cross-loop redundancy through token-sparse updates, sparse attention, and KV-residual quantization. Across several Looped Transformers models, \textsc{FlashLoop} delivers lossless accuracy while achieving up to 1.64$\times$ end-to-end speedup and up to 6$\times$ KV-cache memory reduction, substantially improving the practicality of scaling Looped Transformers to greater computational depths and longer context.
summary: Looped Transformers have attracted substantial attention as a parameter-efficient approach to increasing computational depth through repeated application of shared Transformer blocks. In this paper, we find that much of the additional computation and storage introduced by looping is redundant.
innovations: Building on these observations, we introduce FlashLoop, a training-free inference framework that reduces cross-loop redundancy through token-sparse updates, sparse attention, and KV-residual quantization.

analysis_zh.summary_zh: 该论文关注循环Transformer因重复调用共享块而导致的推理FLOPs与KV缓存随循环深度持续增长的问题，指出循环带来的额外计算与存储存在冗余。作者观察到状态变化集中于少量token、注意力输出差异由稀疏稳定的key列主导、相邻循环KV残差更易低比特量化。据此提出免训练推理框架FlashLoop，通过token稀疏更新、稀疏注意力和KV残差量化降低跨循环冗余，在多个模型上实现无损精度，最高1.64倍端到端加速和6倍KV缓存内存降低。
innovations_zh: 发现循环Transformer跨循环计算与存储存在冗余，状态变化集中于少量token
观察到注意力输出差异由稀疏稳定key列主导，KV残差随循环更易低比特量化
提出免训练FlashLoop，结合token稀疏更新、稀疏注意力和KV残差量化
analysis_zh.significance: 该工作针对循环Transformer参数高效但推理不高效的核心矛盾，通过利用跨循环冗余实现免训练加速与显存压缩，有助于推动循环Transformer在更大计算深度和更长上下文场景中的实际部署，并为循环结构推理优化提供了新思路。
analysis_zh.limitations: 摘要仅报告了多个循环Transformer模型上的结果，未说明具体模型规模、任务类型与评测基准，泛化性仍需验证。免训练方法虽避免重训，但其稀疏与量化策略可能对某些模型或长尾任务敏感，且摘要未给出精度无损的详细判定标准与消融分析。
analysis_zh.potential: 未来可探索将跨循环冗余利用扩展到训练阶段或与其他推理加速技术结合，并研究自适应稀疏度与量化位宽策略。长期看，若能在更多架构和任务上验证，该方法有望成为循环Transformer实际部署的关键推理优化组件。

title: Reference-Based Analysis of Coherence and Diversity in Open-Ended Text Generation
abstract: Evaluating open-ended text generation involves understanding how different properties of a continuation relate to its perceived quality. We present a reference-based framework for examining coherence and diversity through three perspectives: aligning their evolution with human trajectories, comparing their summaries with a human continuation of the same prompt, and estimating their likelihood under a human reference distribution. Experiments with human quality ratings suggest that diversity-based alignment and mean-based comparisons capture quality-related variation, although the comparisons do not establish a predictive advantage for temporal alignment over simpler baselines. Reference likelihood also shows positive associations with ratings, with results varying across reference configurations and scoring horizons. Together, these analyses provide a structured way to examine how measured coherence and diversity relate to human judgments, while distinguishing similarity to human references from quality itself. Code and analysis resources are available at https://github.com/EstebanGarces/likely_human.

analysis_zh.summary_zh: 该研究关注开放式文本生成中连贯性与多样性如何与人类感知质量相关联。作者提出一个基于参考的框架，从三个视角分析：将连贯性与多样性的演化与人类轨迹对齐、将其摘要与同一提示下的人类续写进行比较、以及在人类参考分布下估计其似然。人类质量评分实验表明，基于多样性的对齐和基于均值的比较能捕捉与质量相关的变异，但时间对齐相较简单基线并未显示出预测优势；参考似然与评分呈正相关，且结果随参考配置和评分范围而变化。
innovations_zh: 提出基于参考的框架，从对齐、比较和似然三视角分析连贯性与多样性
将连贯性与多样性的演化轨迹与人类续写轨迹进行对齐评估
利用人类参考分布估计续写似然，并关联人类质量评分
区分与人类参考的相似性和生成质量本身，提供结构化分析方式
analysis_zh.significance: 该工作为开放式文本生成评估提供了一种结构化方法，将连贯性与多样性度量同人类判断联系起来，有助于理解自动指标与感知质量之间的关系。其贡献在于强调参考相似性不等同于质量，并为后续评估指标设计提供分析视角。
analysis_zh.limitations: 摘要仅报告了相关性或关联性结果，未说明是否建立因果或预测性结论；时间对齐未优于简单基线，说明该视角的增量价值有限。结果随参考配置和评分范围变化，表明方法稳定性与泛化性尚不明确，且仅基于摘要无法判断实验规模与任务覆盖范围。
analysis_zh.potential: 未来可进一步探索不同参考配置与评分范围下方法的稳健性，并研究如何将参考似然与质量判断更有效结合。长期看，该框架可启发更细粒度的生成评估，但需更多任务和模型验证其通用性。
